---
description: "Polish a specific screen to AAA visual quality using the design token system and visual audit standard."
agent: Project Lead
argument-hint: "Name the screen to polish (e.g., Home Screen, Game Store, YouTube) and describe what needs improvement."
---

`Project Lead` should dispatch this as UI implementation work through `Senior Engineer`, who uses the `ui-polish-workflow` skill to:

1. Parse the request into a token-specific design brief
2. Inspect current QSS/C++ code for token deviations
3. Build a prioritized punch list
4. Implement fixes
5. Capture screenshots and score against the AAA Visual Audit Standard (≥ 90/100 to pass)

Include:

- which screen or page to polish
- what specifically needs improvement (or "full audit" for a complete review)
- any reference screenshots or specific design direction
